fixes.explanation: Camping is the opposite of the picture here. The LORD says, “No one may go up with you…” and that no one may be seen anywhere on the mountain (Exodus 34:3). So no tents and no lawn chairs up there. Moses is the only one on the guest list.

Yes, baker. Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 4:14), and all the Israelites “…were afraid to approach him.” (Exodus 34:30). Moses doesn't hold back, though. He calls out to them, and then Aaron and the leaders come back to him (Exodus 34:31). Nobody rushes, but they do come.

problems.problem: The line about no neighbors waving from the foothills extends the restriction beyond what the text says. It forbids people on the mountain and grazing in front of it, not people in the foothills.
Saying Moses is the last to know why implies that he learns the reason and establishes an order of discovery. The passage does not say when or whether he learns it.
